mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_tenant ( tenant_code, tenant_nm, admin_email, use_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantSerialCode}, #{tenantNm}, #{adminEmail}, 'Y' )

mapper.update: UPDATE tb_tenant_subscription SET subscription_status = 'EXPIRED', ends_at = COALESCE(ends_at, now()), updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{value} AND subscription_status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_tenant_subscription ( tenant_id, plan_id, subscription_status, starts_at, ends_at, auto_renew, created_by, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{tenantId}, p.plan_id, 'ACTIVE', now(), NULL, 'Y', NULL, now(), now() FROM tb_plan p WHERE p.plan_code = #{planCode} AND p.use_at = 'Y'

UPDATE tb_tenant SET onboarding_status = #{onboardingStatus}, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = ( SELECT tenant_id FROM tb_login_account WHERE login_id = #{loginAccountId} )
UPDATE tb_login_account SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, -- password_algo = 'BCRYPT', use_at = #{useAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE login_id = #{loginAccountId}
UPDATE tb_user SET mobile_no = #{mobileNo}, updated_at = now() WHERE user_id = ( SELECT user_id FROM tb_login_account WHERE login_id = #{loginAccountId} )
UPDATE tb_tenant_domain SET is_primary = 'N', updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{value} AND is_primary = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_tenant_domain ( tenant_id, email_domain, is_primary, use_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{emailDomain}, 'Y', 'Y', now(), now() )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_tenant WHERE corporate_number = #{value} AND use_at = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_tenant WHERE business_registration_number = #{value} AND use_at = 'Y'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_tenant WHERE 1=1
AND tenant_code ILIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND COALESCE(admin_email, '') ILIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND tenant_nm ILIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND use_at = 'Y'
AND use_at = 'N'
AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(onboarding_status), ''), 'EMAIL_QUEUED') = #{onboardingStatus}
AND use_at = #{useAtOnly}

SELECT t.tenant_id, t.tenant_code, t.tenant_nm AS company_name, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(u.user_nm), ''), NULLIF(split_part(COALESCE(t.admin_email, ''), '@', 1), ''), '-' ) AS admin_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.admin_email), ''), '-') AS admin_email, CASE WHEN t.use_at = 'Y' THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'INACTIVE' END AS status, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.onboarding_status), ''), 'EMAIL_QUEUED') AS onboarding_status, COALESCE(p.plan_code, '-') AS plan_code, COALESCE(p.plan_nm, '-') AS plan_name, TO_CHAR(t.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS created_at, t.corporate_number, t.business_type, t.business_category FROM tb_tenant t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.tenant_id) s.tenant_id, s.plan_id FROM tb_tenant_subscription s WHERE s.subscription_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY s.tenant_id, s.starts_at DESC ) ts ON ts.tenant_id = t.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_plan p ON p.plan_id = ts.plan_id LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u.email_addr), ''), '-') = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.admin_email), ''), '-') WHERE 1=1
AND t.tenant_code ILIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND COALESCE(t.admin_email, '') ILIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND t.tenant_nm ILIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND t.use_at = 'Y'
AND t.use_at = 'N'
ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET (#{pageIndex} * #{pageSize})

SELECT t.tenant_id, t.tenant_code, t.tenant_nm AS company_name, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(u.user_nm), ''), NULLIF(split_part(COALESCE(t.admin_email, ''), '@', 1), ''), '-' ) AS admin_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.admin_email), ''), '-') AS admin_email, CASE WHEN t.use_at = 'Y' THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'INACTIVE' END AS status, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.onboarding_status), ''), 'EMAIL_QUEUED') AS onboarding_status, COALESCE(p.plan_code, '-') AS plan_code, COALESCE(p.plan_nm, '-') AS plan_name, TO_CHAR(t.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS created_at, t.corporate_number, t.business_type, t.business_category FROM tb_tenant t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.tenant_id) s.tenant_id, s.plan_id FROM tb_tenant_subscription s WHERE s.subscription_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY s.tenant_id, s.starts_at DESC ) ts ON ts.tenant_id = t.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_plan p ON p.plan_id = ts.plan_id LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u.email_addr), ''), '-') = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.admin_email), ''), '-') WHERE UPPER(t.tenant_code) = UPPER(#{value}) LIMIT 1

SELECT tenant_id, tenant_code, tenant_nm AS company_name, business_registration_number, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(admin_email), ''), '-') AS admin_email, TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS issued_at FROM tb_tenant ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.tenant_id, t.tenant_code, t.tenant_nm, t.admin_email, t.corporate_number, t.business_type, t.business_category, t.logo_image, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.onboarding_status), ''), 'EMAIL_QUEUED') AS onboarding_status, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.created_by, t.use_at FROM tb_tenant t JOIN tb_tenant_domain td ON td.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE t.use_at = 'Y' AND td.use_at = 'Y' AND td.email_domain = #{domain} ORDER BY CASE WHEN td.is_primary = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, td.tenant_domain_id LIMIT 1

SELECT tenant_id, tenant_code, tenant_nm, admin_email, corporate_number, business_type, business_category, logo_image, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(onboarding_status), ''), 'EMAIL_QUEUED') AS onboarding_status, created_at, updated_at, created_by, use_at FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_tenant_database ( tenant_id, db_key, db_name, jdbc_url, jdbc_username, jdbc_password_secret_ref, driver_class_name, schema_name, pool_min_idle, pool_max_size, provisioning_status, use_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{dbKey}, #{dbName}, #{jdbcUrl}, #{jdbcUsername}, #{jdbcPasswordSecretRef}, 'org.postgresql.Driver', #{schemaName}, 1, 5, 'PENDING', 'Y', NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_tenant_database SET provisioning_status = #{provisioningStatus}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT td.tenant_id, td.db_key, td.jdbc_url, td.jdbc_username, td.jdbc_password_secret_ref, td.schema_name, td.provisioning_status, td.use_at FROM tb_tenant_database td WHERE td.tenant_id = #{value} AND td.use_at = 'Y' LIMIT 1

SELECT td.tenant_id, td.db_key, td.jdbc_url, td.jdbc_username, td.jdbc_password_secret_ref, td.schema_name, td.provisioning_status, td.use_at FROM tb_tenant_domain domain JOIN tb_tenant_database td ON td.tenant_id = domain.tenant_id WHERE domain.email_domain = #{value} AND domain.use_at = 'Y' AND td.use_at = 'Y' ORDER BY CASE WHEN domain.is_primary = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, domain.tenant_domain_id LIMIT 1
